profile.headline: Principal AI Engineer  — Amplitude, AI Foundation

positions.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
* Technical lead for AI Avatar Stylization efforts aiming to provide ways to tailor existing avatars to new aesthetic or geometric requirements while preserving key identifying pieces. Using generative models, this allows people to say "use this new body model and make me look more like a cell-shaded robot character" and see newly generated avatars for themselves. 

* Technical development lead for Photo2Avatar launch: providing identity-preserving, generative avatar creation from photo inputs. This enabled Roblox to use generative AI to provide stylized avatars tailored to look like the user (who provides an initial photo of themselves to specify identity features). 

* Developed Game Engine Control Optimization by leveraging sequence modeling to forecast future state and predict/orchestrate optimal movements across a range of level of detail (LOD) control parameters to effect best player outcomes.

positions.title: Senior Manager, Data Science — Trust & Safety
positions.description:
* Provided technical direction and strategy consultation across a wide scope for the totality of Data Science efforts within Safety at Roblox. This involved both ML modeling and analytics across Account Security (bots/account compromise), Player Safety, Content Safety, and Safety Operations Efficiency. 

* Built Safety Data Science from the ground up via crafting and aligning on metrics and Northstar goals, analyzing and prioritizing Safety threats across Roblox, and building proactive detection systems for policy-violating content and behaviors.

* Scaled Safety Data Science organization from 4 to 13 members over 2 years.

positions.title: Group Manager — Data Science
positions.description:
TurboTax Onboarding Prediction: Managed the development for onboarding recommendations. This involved using traditional ML methods while inferring missing data at various stages of user profile generation to suggest financial topics that are relevant to a user filing their taxes. 

Document Understanding: Led a team of 6 Data Scientists and Engineers on continuing development for improvements in our document understanding efforts across Intuit.

positions.title: Principal Data Scientist
positions.description: Pioneered and led development of efforts for entity extraction from a variety of financial documents. Tech lead for the release of a generalized system for ML-based information extraction from financial documents in production across Intuit's product landscape using a combination of transformer-based language modeling and object/text image detection. This effort then grew to encompass a team that I began managing in 2020 and grew to 6 people.

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
User Conversion Modeling: Clustering and segmenting users based on event logs of on-site behavior. Clickstream conversion modeling using recurrent neural networks to identify and reduce friction during the signup steps. 

Growth Analytics: Exploratory analytics aimed at helping to direct further acquisition A/B testing efforts. Highly granular funnel analysis over a wide range of regions and device types. Opportunity sizing analyses to determine the possible predicted revenue of testing initiatives in order to aid in test prioritization.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Generative Modeling Designed convolutional VAE, GAN and hybrid VAE/GAN model architectures for unsupervised feature extraction of style image data. Released fauxtograph software to provide easy-to-use generative modeling API/CLI in Python.

Predictive Modeling: Modeled marginal probability of style purchase from clothing imagery, improving absolute variance explained by 10% over naive class-conditional modeling. Designed and trained model to simultaneously predict style attributes and type classification for "in-the-wild" clothing image data with applications for future attribute trend analysis on large-scale social media data.

Recommendation Systems: Implemented large-scale production pipeline for ingesting social media data from Pinterest imagery to provide client-level recommendations of inventory via cross-domain image retrieval using siamese networks. Prototyped hybrid LDA/visual feature vector recommendation pipeline based on client comments and feedback ratings of previously sent clothing styles.

Misc: Built automated clothing measurement system with novel expectation-maximization template matching. Created automated color extraction and naming pipeline for internal clothing inventory.

positions.title: Data Science Fellow
positions.description: Built a project to automatically scrape photos and geo data from Flickr and use computer vision to then map out places to take great photos of specific types of landscape.

projects.title: fauxtograph
projects.description: A Python module and command line tool for training a variational auto-encoder model on image data. See a longer description in the blog post: http://multithreaded.stitchfix.com/blog/2015/09/17/deep-style/

projects.title: Random-Walk.us
projects.description: Scenery discovery application which utilizes deep learning to classify Flickr photos according to scenery type and plot their geolocation to aid users in finding new adventure locations.

patents.title: Pre-trained contextual embedding models for named entity recognition and confidence prediction
patents.description: At least one processor may obtain a document comprising text tokens. The at least one processor may determine, based on a pre-trained language model, word embeddings corresponding to the text tokens. The at least one processor may determine, based on the word embeddings, named entities corresponding to the text tokens; and one or more accuracy predictions corresponding to the named entities. The at least one processor may compare the one or more accuracy predictions with at least one threshold. The at least one processor may associate, based on the comparing, the named entities with one or more confidence levels. The at last one processor may deliver the named entities and the one or more confidence levels.

patents.title: Supervised machine learning algorithm application for image cropping and skew rectification
patents.description: Systems and methods here may be used for pre-processing images, including using a computer for receiving a pixelated image of a paper document of an original size, downscaling the received pixelated image, employing a neural network algorithm to the downscaled image to identify four corners of the paper document in the received pixelated image, re-enlarging the downscaled image to the original size, identifying each of four corners of the paper document in the pixelated image, determining a quadrilateral composed of lines that intersect at four angles at the four corners of the paper document in the pixelated image, defining a projective plane of the pixelated image, and determining an inverse transformation of the pixelated image to transform the projective plane quadrilateral into a right angled rectangle.
